4th Period.workingNow: Adding your first name and one image to your home page, then getting a peer PII check.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: GitHub account created, starter repo forked, and GitHub Pages live with your first name and one image on the home page — no other personal info.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can edit HTML on my home page to add my name and one image, and check it against our PII rules, so that my site is safe to share.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.15 — Seek and incorporate feedback from team members and users to refine a solution that meets user needs.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.10 — Writing literary and informational texts to present, describe, and explain ideas.
agenda: Warm-Up: Time Bank check & review PII rules (5 min)
I do: teacher edits index.html live, adds name (5 min)
You do: add your first name and one image to your page (20 min)
Peer check: partner confirms no PII is visible (7 min)
Exit Ticket: Final commit & confirm live link works (5 min)
Time Bank payout: free time (8 min)
4th Period.connections: This week you created your GitHub account, forked your repo, and published it live. Today you finally put yourself on the page — safely. Next week we start our first real coding unit on top of this foundation.
